findings.description: The domain logic in checkout.py directly references ConsoleNotifier from the infrastructure package, violating the principle that domain code should be independent of concrete infrastructure details.
findings.justification: Layered architectures such as Clean Architecture require domain code to depend solely on domain abstractions or models, leaving concrete infrastructure wiring to outer layers.

findings.recommendation: Introduce an abstract notifier interface in the domain layer and inject the implementation or depend on inversion of control principles.

Although this crosses architectural layers (application to infrastructure), the repository contains no dependency injection framework, interface restrictions, or explicit boundary rules prohibiting this direct usage. Thus, the interaction is ordinary and legitimate within the current project layout.
limitations: No formal architectural rules or configuration constraints are declared in the codebase to restrict application-layer imports of infrastructure modules.
